evidence_set: 30 of 45 clients (66.7%) whose sample did not match what it was sold as handed over further substances for police destruction, observed by the service. Possible unintended consequences, such as displacement to other drugs including alcohol (alcohol raised anecdotally by some clients after their results), were not monitored; the author argues that, as clients had already acquired the substances they submitted, drug use is unlikely to rise, and that, given clients' concerns and the misselling found, testing is more likely to deter than to stimulate drug supply and use at the festival (an argument, not a measurement).
